raw.description:
Your mission

About L1VE
L1VE is a growing media and technology company with offices in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K/3D/360° streaming technology and innovative live formats, we are changing the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

Your Role

You are the voice of L1VE online. You build our social media from the ground up, take full ownership of it and work closely with our Content & Experience team. You report to the Head of Marketing & Sales. As the function grows, you can build your own team. You will work remote within Europe or the USA, or on-site in Berlin or New York

What You'll Do

  • Own all L1VE social media channels (Reddit, TikTok, Instagram, X; YouTube optional), incl. strategy, tone of voice and content calendar
  • Build and lead our own subreddit, our main place for talking with the community
  • Create platform-native short-form video (TikTok, Reels) that shows what it feels like to be there live with a VR headset, incl. ideas, scripts, editing and trend monitoring
  • Create content hands-on together with our content team
  • Manage community engagement across all channels, fast and in the L1VE voice
  • Create real-time content around our live events, optionally on site
  • Brief and manage freelancers, agencies, creators and on-site event partners, incl. quality control
  • Report on reach, engagement, follower growth and traffic, and feed learnings straight into the next content
  • Attend selected live events, including occasional international trips

Your profile

Must-have

  • 3–5 years of social media management experience for a brand, publisher, sports club, league or agency
  • A portfolio of your own posts, videos or campaigns with proven results
  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram: formats, algorithms, trends and internet culture
  • Experience with Reddit and its communities
  • Hands-on short-form video skills: concept, shooting and editing (e.g. CapCut, Premiere)
  • Excellent written and spoken English (German is a plus)
  • Strong sense of ownership and a hands-on mentality: you build things from scratch and see them through

Nice-to-have

  • Experience working with freelancers or agencies
  • Practical experience with AI tools, ideally with concrete use cases
  • Data-driven approach using platform analytics
  • Interest in sports, entertainment and immersive technology

Why us?

  • You work with live content from international sports and entertainment events that you won't find anywhere else.
  • You get plenty of creative freedom, short decision paths and flexible hours.

Interested?

Send us your CV, links to two or three posts or videos you're proud of, your day rate, and a few sentences on why you're a great fit for L1VE.
L1VE is committed to equal opportunities. We welcome applications regardless of origin, gender, age, religion, disability or sexual identity.

Contact person

Annette Hansen - Recruiting Manager

Über BringLiesel

BringLiesel ist die Plattform für individuelle Bewohnerversorgung in der stationären Pfege. Über 1.200 Produkte des täglichen Bedarfs werden online bestellt, einzeln je Bewohner:in verpackt und revisionssicher abgerechnet. Unsere Prozesse sind dabei tief in den Alltag der Pfege und Betreuung integriert. Über 2.300 Einrichtungen und mehr als 80.000 Pfegebedürftige vertrauen uns bereits. Unser Anspruch: Selbstbestimmung für Bewohner:innen. Entlastung für Pfege und Verwaltung. Efzienz für den Träger.

Deine Rolle

Wir befnden uns in einer Wachstumsphase – und diese Rolle ist ihr Motor im Bestand: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den gesamten Customer-Success-Prozess von BringLiesel, von der erfolgreichen Anbindung neuer Einrichtungen bis zu ihrem nachhaltigen Ausbau. Du brauchst dafür beides – eine ausgeprägte Hands-on- und Macher-Mentalität für das operative Tagesgeschäft und den strategischen Weitblick, um die Rolle neu zu defnieren und BringLiesel für die Zukunft aufzustellen. Du holst dein Team operativ ab, führst es strategisch und setzt die richtigen Initiativen. Dabei führst du drei Account Manager, die die Einrichtungen onboarden und begleiten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Vom Onboarding bis zum Ausbau: Verantwortung für den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Einrichtungen – von der Anbindung über die Etablierung im Pfegealltag bis zum kontinuierlichen Ausbau.
  • Wachstum im Bestand: Du stärkst die Durchdringung in den Einrichtungen (mehr Bewohnende pro Einrichtung), baust die Warenkörbe aus und etablierst BringLiesel fest im Alltag der Einrichtung.
  • Führung & Entwicklung: Fachliche und persönliche Führung von drei Account Managern, die die Einrichtungen onboarden und begleiten.
  • Zusammenspiel mit Marketing: Enge, gestaltende Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing und Digital Customer Experience als zentraler Wachstumshebel.
  • Strategische Weiterentwicklung: Du defnierst die Rolle neu, setzt die richtigen Initiativen und Prozesse und stellst den Bereich zukunftsfest auf.
  • Steuerung über Kennzahlen: Du machst Durchdringung, Warenkorb und Kundenbindung messbar und sorgst dafür, dass die Kennzahlen auch wirken.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Success, Account- oder Bestandskundenmanagement, idealerweise mit Führungsverantwortung.
  • Du denkst und handelst strategisch UND operativ – mit klarer Hands-on- und Macher-Mentalität.
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge im Ausbau von Bestandskunden (Durchdringung, Upsell, Warenkorb) –gerne datengetrieben.
  • Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing.
  • Führungskompetenz: Du entwickelst ein kleines Team und gehst als Vorbild voran.
  • Kommunikationsstark und empathisch – gerade im sensiblen Pfegeumfeld wichtig.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Was wir bieten

  • Die Chance, den Customer Success bei BringLiesel neu zu defnieren und für die Zukunftaufzustellen – eine Rolle, die du von Anfang an prägst.
  • Führungsverantwortung für ein dreiköpfges Account-Management-Team.
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Wachstumsphase: BringLiesel wächst, und diese Rolle wächst mit.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du trägst direkt dazu bei, dass Pfegebedürftige selbstbestimmt einkaufen können.
  • Standort wahlweise Lübeck oder Hamburg – mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Kontakt zu allen Teams.

Kontakt

Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung an den Chief Commercial Ofcer.

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description: Über BringLiesel BringLiesel ist die Plattform für individuelle Bewohnerversorgung in der stationären Pflege. Über 1.200 Produkte des täglichen Bedarfs werden online bestellt, einzeln je Bewohner:in verpackt und revisionssicher abgerechnet. Unsere Prozesse sind dabei tief in den Alltag der Pflege und Betreuung integriert. Über 2.300 Einrichtungen und mehr als 80.000 Pflegebedürftige vertrauen uns bereits. Unser Anspruch: Selbstbestimmung für Bewohner:innen. Entlastung für Pflege und Verwaltung. Effizienz für den Träger. Deine Rolle Wir befinden uns in einer Wachstumsphase – und diese Rolle steht in ihrem Zentrum: Wir richten unseren Vertrieb strategisch auf die Träger-Ebene aus und stellen unser Geschäftsmodell auf ein SaaS-Lizenzmodell um. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die mittleren bis großen Träger: von der Neuakquise über die Vertragsverhandlung bis zum Ausbau und der SaaS-Transformation im Bestand. Du brauchst dafür beides – strategischen Weitblick für die Accountplanung und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität in der Umsetzung. Die größten Träger betreust du dabei gemeinsam mit dem Chief Commercial Officer. Deine Aufgaben Neuakquise auf Trägerebene: Du gewinnst neue mittlere bis große Träger und führst Gespräche und Verhandlungen auf Entscheider- und Geschäftsführungsebene. Ausbau & SaaS-Transformation im Bestand: Du überführst bestehende Träger auf das neue Lizenzmodell und baust die Zusammenarbeit strategisch aus. Vertrags- & Preisverhandlung: Du argumentierst das Preismodell überzeugend und führst Verhandlungen eigenverantwortlich bis zum Abschluss. Strategische Accountplanung: Du entwickelst je Träger eine klare Wachstums- und Migrationsstrategie und priorisierst deine Pipeline eigenständig. Operative Umsetzung: Du treibst Rollouts aktiv voran und packst hands-on mit an – von der ersten Ansprache bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag. Enge Zusammenarbeit: Gestaltende Abstimmung mit Account Management, Customer Success, Vertriebsassistenz und Marketing entlang der gesamten Customer Journey. Dein Profil Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Key Account Management – idealerweise im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen (SaaS oder Dienstleistung). Branchenkenntnis in der Pflege bzw. im Gesundheitswesen ist ein deutliches Plus. Ausgeprägte Verhandlungs- und Abschlussstärke auf Entscheider- und Geschäftsführungsebene. Du denkst und handelst strategisch UND operativ – mit klarer Hands-on-Mentalität. Erfahrung im Auf- und Ausbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen mit mittleren bis großen Organisationen. Kommunikationsstark und empathisch – gerade im sensiblen Pflegeumfeld wichtig. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie bundesweite Reisebereitschaft. Was wir bieten Eine Schlüsselrolle in der SaaS-Transformation von BringLiesel – du gestaltest den Vertrieb auf Trägerebene maßgeblich mit. Große Eigenverantwortung: Du steuerst deine Träger strategisch und operativ selbst. Viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Wachstumsphase: BringLiesel wächst, und diese Rolle wächst mit. Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du trägst direkt dazu bei, dass Pflegebedürftige selbstbestimmt einkaufen können. Remote, deutschlandweit – flexibel organisiert, mit regelmäßigem Austausch im Team und bei Bedarf vor Ort. Kontakt Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung an den Chief Commercial Officer. title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.  We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across UK, Germany, and Spain. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio. We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience. Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance. Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis. Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension. Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet. Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction. Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.   Your Profile: 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup. A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit. Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features. Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring. Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them. Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders. A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus. Fluent English required Our hiring process : TA Call : Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better. Technical Round : Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case) , and meet your potential manager. Final Round : Meet other Atollians 🏝️ It varies from 1 to 3 interviews *Some processes might slightly change according to needs Ready to apply? Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster. We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English. *Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role. #LI-PM1 At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.  As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment. Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner. The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.   Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Client Delivery Lead (m/w/d)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Was wir tun: Wir entwickeln die innovativste, zukunftsorientierteste und am stärksten KI-gestützte Plattform für Energiemanagement. Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran. Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt. Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann. 🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns: Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte. Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen. Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden. 🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung: Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich. Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen. Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern. Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen. Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen. Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung. Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt in Europa; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt. Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du eigeninitiativ handeln und bereit sein, selbst mit anzupacken, um Probleme zu lösen. Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen. Du stehst hinter dem Kraken-Ansatz zur Technologieentwicklung, der auf Einfachheit, Kundennutzen und Effizienz beruht, und begleitest die beteiligten Interessengruppen durch den Veränderungsprozess. Du bist bereit, bestehende Überzeugungen zu hinterfragen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven einzunehmen und bei Bedarf auch über deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich hinauszugehen, um den Kunden zu unterstützen. Wir entwickeln Kraken für alle: eine universelle Plattform, bei der gemeinsam genutzte Weiterentwicklungen einen größeren Nutzen schaffen und die grüne Energiewende ermöglichen. Als Pioniere auf diesem Gebiet begeistert uns, wie Kraken das Leben unserer Kunden verändern kann. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Kraken die beste Lösung ist – sowohl für mehr Effizienz als auch als Werkzeug im Kampf gegen die Klimakrise. Wenn du diese Überzeugung teilst, bist du bei Kraken Tech genau richtig. 🧠 Das bringst du mit: In dieser Position steht die Erfüllung der Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden für dich im Mittelpunkt. Wir suchen Menschen mit ausgeprägter Problemlösungskompetenz und einer durchweg positiven, lösungsorientierten Einstellung. Wenn du Herausforderungen gerne annimmst und den Ehrgeiz hast, erfolgreich zu sein, passt diese Position zu dir! Deine Haltung: „Jedes Problem hat eine Lösung. Neue Herausforderungen sind spannend, weil wir durch sie jeden Tag besser werden. Und je größer die Herausforderung, desto größer das Erfolgserlebnis.“ Fundierte Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten und/oder als Product Owner. Erfahrung mit agilen Umsetzungsmethoden. Erfahrung im Produktmanagement und mit Customer Journeys. Ein solides Verständnis von Technologie und den damit verbundenen Trends. Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Team- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten. Überzeugungskraft und die Fähigkeit, traditionelle Denkweisen zu hinterfragen. Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit umfangreichen, komplexen Projekt- und Umsetzungspipelines für Kunden. Geduld und Eigeninitiative: Unsere Kunden durchlaufen tiefgreifende Veränderungen, die Zeit brauchen und unser Verständnis erfordern. Gutes Zeitmanagement und eine tatkräftige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise. Beratungserfahrung ist von Vorteil. Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse. Vorerfahrung in Buchhaltung und Abrechnung oder im Zahlungsverkehr sowie Kenntnisse in FI/CO sind von Vorteil. Da wir ein internationales Unternehmen sind, bitten wir dich, deinen Lebenslauf auf Englisch einzureichen und die Fragen in deiner Bewerbung auf Englisch zu beantworten. Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Die Position ist die eines Client Delivery Lead Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at ----- We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best! Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. *Our (i) Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Notice , (ii) Website Privacy Notice and (iii) Cookie Notice govern the collection and use of your personal data in connection with your application and use of our website. These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve read, understood and consent to these terms Please note that, in line with our current recruitment policy, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position; applicants must have the right to work in the country that they're applying to, at the time of application.* Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Head of Product
raw.description:
Head of Product

Our mission for you

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk — and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex — combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings — all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.


We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast — the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

We're looking for a Head of Product to own vision, strategy, and execution across the entire customer journey. You'll report directly to the CEO, with close collaboration with the CTO and COO. You will join the leadership team alongside other department leaders. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again — and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the headquarters in Berlin with our international, dynamic team.

Your team

You will lead a well-established team of 6 Product Managers and Designers embedded in 6 interdisciplinary teams in Product & Engineering. You will be the key decision-maker for what the teams work on. Our main customer segment is the German Mittelstand, therefore fluent German is required for this position.

You'll drive the evolution of three key areas:

Product Vision & Strategy: Own the product vision for the customer-facing products and roadmap across Supply, Manage, and Flex. Turn market dynamics and customer pain into a clear, prioritized strategy that compounds value across products. Internal products such as Trading platform as well as Energy Utility Platform are out of scope for this role.

Value Delivery at Scale: Drive execution across teams, products, and geographies. Own the metrics that matter. Turn data into decisions and trade-offs into momentum.

Team & Organisation: Build and lead high-performing product teams. Partner with Engineering, Design, GTM, and Operations. Create an environment where exceptional people do their best work.

Who we are looking for

Product Vision Leader: You deeply understand customer problems and translate them into a compelling product vision that aligns the entire company. You communicate strategy with clarity and conviction. You rally cross-functional teams around shared goals.

Product Excellence: You have excelled as a Product Leader (Staff, Head of, VP) at a fast-paced scale-up. Proven track record of shipping products customers love that drive measurable business results.

Value Delivery at Scale: You lead teams that deliver value at scale — shipping regularly, holding themselves accountable to outcomes, not just output. You set the bar for execution quality and speed across products, teams, and markets.

Software Builder: Expert in building B2B software products, ideally experienced with working with customers in the Commercial & Industrial segment. You understand and master software product dynamics — activation, retention, pricing and upsell along the full customer lifecycle.

Seasoned Executor: You deliver in high-paced environments with clear target achievement. You thrive in uncertainty — creating structure, driving momentum, and turning ambiguity into action. You prioritize with clarity and ship relentlessly.

AI-Native Builder: At trawa, we embrace new technology and use it to our competitive advantage. Core decision processes in trading and energy operations run on AI-based predictions. Customer success, sales enablement as well as Operations are fueled by agentic workflows. We are reinventing what a modern utility looks like — driving cost-to-serve toward €0 and increasing trading profits through AI-based signal processing. You will have the mandate and the environment to reinvent product development, tooling, and ways of working with AI across the organization.

Energy Expert (Strong Plus): Deep energy market expertise is beneficial — but not a prerequisite.

At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply — you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.


90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):

  • You deeply understand trawa's business and product

  • You have established your philosophy of running Product & Tech teams’ delivery

  • You shape new quarterly roadmap and OKR plans for your teams

  • You have assembled the company around your product vision for the entire customer journey

  • Your vision for the customer journey comes to live - first key metrics are moved

  • Your teams follow your rhythm of value delivery in fast measurable iterations

Why us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity — most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your product will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage, and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

The Role: This is a rare opportunity to own product end-to-end at a company where product is the business. You won't be managing a feature backlog — you'll be shaping a platform that spans energy trading, real-time asset steering, and enterprise software. Few product roles in Europe offer this combination of complexity, commercial impact, and speed.

Responsibility & Support: You'll join the leadership team with direct impact on company strategy. We support you through regular leadership sessions, cross-department leadership initiatives, and experienced mentors who want to see you succeed.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

The Drone Port enables our UAV platforms to launch, land, charge and return to mission readiness autonomously. As a Senior Hardware Engineer, you will be the technical point of contact for core hardware topics across the Drone Port product. You will guide hardware development from concept and prototypes through verification and validation, supporting the product lifecycle through series readiness and customer demonstrations. You will work closely with Mechanical Engineering, Embedded Software, Systems Engineering, Testing, Manufacturing, Procurement and external development partners and suppliers. Your work will help deliver reliable, available and manufacturable hardware for current and future Drone Port generations. What is your Day to Day Mission: Act as the technical point of contact for key hardware topics across the Drone Port product. Develop and assess hardware concepts for future Drone Port generations, and support architecture and design decisions. Guide the hardware development lifecycle from concept through prototypes, technical verification and system validation. Contribute to PCB, wiring harness and system designs with internal teams and external development partners. Plan, build and commission hardware prototypes, and support integration, testing and customer demonstrations. Provide technical leadership to the hardware and electronics development team, and technical support to the Drone Port Testing team. Support Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering and Manufacturing with hardware expertise. Own hardware bills of materials, component availability and technical documentation, keeping records accurate and current. Coordinate technical orders and manage hardware inventory and development materials incl. in-house workshop management.  Work with Procurement, Manufacturing and suppliers to ensure hardware is available when development milestones require it. Prepare hardware procurement decisions in line with defined budgets and development needs. Deliver hardware solutions on time and meet product quality and reliability goals. Continuously improve the hardware architecture for robustness, maintainability and manufacturability, and support the technical development of future Drone Port generations. What you bring to the team: A degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a comparable discipline. Several years of professional experience developing technical systems and designing hardware. Strong CAD skills; familiarity with CATIA V5 is an advantage. Experience building and testing electronic and mechanical prototypes. Experience industrialising prototypes and transitioning them into series production. Experience working with bills of materials, component management and suppliers. A structured, self-directed and solution-oriented approach to work. Excellent written and spoken English. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains. If you feel energized by fast pace, big ambitions and want to build something meaningful in the security domain — you’ll find a strong fit at Exeon Analytics. The Sales Director DACH will play a key leadership role in developing and executing the regional sales strategy to accelerate growth and expand our presence across the Enterprise Market and Mid-Market segments in the DACH region. This role requires a strong understanding of complex enterprise sales and procurement processes, excellent relationship building skills, and the ability to translate strategy into consistent sales execution. You will lead and develop a team of sales professionals while driving revenue growth, customer acquisition, and increase market share across the region. As a DACH Sales Director of Sales, you will be a core member of our Commercial Leadership Team and thus closely collaborate with the Channel and Marketing teams. You will contribute to and execute the go-to-market & revenue growth strategy for Exeon Analytics in the DACH region and work closely with leadership. This is a high-impact role: your hunter attitude (creating win-win situations with our customers, activate networks, develop relationships) paired with methodological discipline (process, metrics, playbooks) plus your hunger to roll up sleeves, build pipeline, and drive predictable revenue growth will enable success. Key responsibilities: Build, manage and coach a high-performing team in the DACH region: direct reports include enterprise and mid-market account executives. Cultivate performance-driven sales culture: high drive, accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, hands-on execution. Forecast revenue, manage pipeline health, report to the Chief Revenue Officer; deliver against growth targets and scale-up metrics (CAC, sales cycle length, renewal/expansion). Own full sales cycle for key target accounts in the region: personally engage in large enterprise / strategic deals, drive negotiations, close major contracts. Apply sales methodologies and process, build sales-enablement and data-driven insights: value-maps, customer case-studies, competitive positioning; use analytics to optimise win-rates, conversion, sales velocity. Opportunity management and development: support the regional sales team in driving complex sales opportunities from qualification through close, navigating procurement processes including RFPs and RFQs while effectively managing key stakeholders and commercial requirements. Contract negotiation and execution: lead commercial and contract negotiations in collaboration with cross-functional teams, ensuring timely execution and a seamless transition from deal closure to customer onboarding. Collaborate cross-functionally: work with marketing (account-based marketing), channel (System Integrators, VAD, Resellers, MSSPs) and product (feedback & positioning). Actively support major and strategic deals through negotiation and closing, while building and maintaining strong relationships with sales leaders across our key regional partners. Stay abreast of cybersecurity & security analytics market trends, competitor landscape, regulatory/compliance drivers (e.g., NIS2, DORA) and use this knowledge to refine sales approach. What makes a good person-job-fit: We are looking for a proactive, self-motivated and enthusiastic individual who’s comfortable in a high-paced scale-up environment and who shares  our values.  In addition, we are looking for certain requirements and skills to establish a good person-job-fit: Minimum 8 years in B2B enterprise software sales (preferably cybersecurity platform) with proven track record of scaling revenue throughout different growth phases, ideally scale-up experience. Experience in leading and building sales teams with hiring, training, mentoring and performance management. You build trust, coach your team, but also hold them accountable. Strong personal network of relevant enterprise customers, decision-makers, and industry stakeholders across the DACH market. Strong methodological sales orientation: experience implementing structured sales frameworks (MEDDPICC), setting KPIs, establishing process discipline and metrics. Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities, experienced in developing and executing complex sales strategies, contract negotiation, and operational leadership. Hands-on mentality: comfortable personally selling major deals, rolling up sleeves in a scale-up context. Ability to work cross-functionally and influence peers, leaders and external partners. High energy, resilience and competitive drive: you get motivated by growth, targets, building something meaningful. Strong written and verbal communication in English and German. Passion for cybersecurity and the culture of a fast-growing scale-up Education Bachelor's Degree or MBA preferred Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Delivery Manager (m/w/d)
description: Kurzbeschreibung Führende Unternehmen wie Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, BMW, Bosch und Rheinmetall setzen auf SPREADs Software, um ihren Ingenieur- und Expertenteams zu ermöglichen, die Komplexität softwaredefinierter Fahrzeuge und Produkte souverän zu beherrschen. Unsere auf EE & SW spezialisierte Datenkontextualisierungs-Software verwandelt komplexe Produktdaten in leicht nutzbare Engineering Intelligence . Vorkonfigurierte Anwendungen und KI-Agenten helfen Teams, entscheidendes Produktwissen gezielt einzusetzen – so können Fahrzeuge und andere komplexe Produkte bis zu zehnmal schneller, zu halbierten Kosten und in besserer Qualität auf den Markt gebracht werden. Das gelingt durch automatisierte Erkenntnisse, die bessere Produktentscheidungen und deren Umsetzung unterstützen und dafür sorgen, dass Zeit-, Qualitäts- und Budgetziele im gesamten Produktlebenszyklus konsequent erreicht oder übertroffen werden. Für seine innovative Technologie hat SPREAD bereits zahlreiche Auszeichnungen erhalten, darunter den SPARK KI-Innovationspreis vom Handelsblatt & McKinsey 2024. Zudem ist SPREAD Teil der EU AI Champions Initiative und zählt zu den LinkedIn Top 20 Startups in DACH. Deine Verantwortung End-to-End-Steuerung von SPREAD-Delivery-Projekten vom Sales-Handover bis Go-Live und Hypercare: Festlegung ambitionierter Ziele und Zeitpläne in Abstimmung mit vereinbarten Erfolgskriterien sowie Sicherstellung der Lieferung im definierten Leistungsumfang, innerhalb von Zeitplan und Budget. Sicherstellung der Delivery durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Engineering und Product Teams sowie Kunden-Teams um das Projekt ins Ziel zu bringen: von der Anbindung von Datenquellen über die Integration in unseren Engineering Intelligence Graph bis zur Konfiguration von Anwendungen in SPREAD Studio und dem Einsatz von KI Agenten zur Lösung konkreter Use Cases mit messbarem Mehrwert. Planung und Moderation technischer und explorativer Workshops sowie Steuerung von UAT , Cutover und Adoption für Zielgruppen, in Abstimmung mit den von Value Engineering definierten Zielen. Koordination funktionsübergreifender Workstreams und Steuerung von Risiken, Annahmen, Entscheidungen und Änderungen mit klaren Executive-Updates und Stakeholder-gerechter Kommunikation. Transparentes Tracking und Kommunikation intern und an unsere Kunden bzgl. des Delivery Status und Reife sowie Value-Trackings und Dokumentation. Systematische Rückführung von Erkenntnissen aus Kundenprojekten in die Produktentwicklung zur Verbesserung von Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Wiederverwendung über Kunden hinweg. Deine Erfahrung Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Durchführung oder Steuerung komplexer Enterprise-Software-Projekte , idealerweise in Engineering-intensiven Branchen wie Automotive, Aerospace, Defence oder Maschinenbau. Erfahrung in Projekten mit Anbindung heterogener IT-Systeme und Abbildung von Entitäten in ein einheitliches Datenmodell sowie Vertrautheit mit APIs und Sicherheitsanforderungen . Fähigkeit zur Durchführung strukturierter Workshops sowie klare schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation für technische Zielgruppen als auch für die Führungsebene. Souveräne Kommunikation intern und gegenüber Kunden, auch in kritischen Situationen und Eskalationen, mit gezielter Steuerung der Stakeholder und Sicherstellung aller Voraussetzungen fpr einen erfolgreichen Rollout (z.B. Datenkonnektoren). Ausgeprägte Ergebnisorientierung mit konsequenter Verknüpfung von Deliverables zu messbarem Wert sowie Steuerung aller Projektphasen anhand transparenter KPIs. Kollaborative, organisierte und hands-on Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, Erkenntnisse aus Projekten in standardisierte Komponenten und Rollout-Playbooks zu überführen. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Warum SPREAD? Innovationsführer : Unsere Agentic‑Engineering‑Intelligence‑Plattform verknüpft Hardware‑ und Software‑Daten zu dynamischen Produkt Zwillingen – darauf agieren KI‑Agenten, die Compliance‑Checks, Abhängigkeitsanalysen und Spezifikationsaufbereitung automatisieren. Das Ergebnis: 10× schnellere Time‑to‑Market und 50% geringere Lifecycle‑Kosten bei OEMs wie VW, Mercedes‑Benz und Rheinmetall. ; Relevanz für die Industrie : Sobald Produkte software‑definiert sind, stößt klassisches PLM an ihre Grenzen. Mit SPREAD führst du Hersteller in die Daten‑ und KI‑Ära – und eröffnest ihnen Einsparungen in Millionenhöhe. H. per‑Wachstum & Ownership : Seit 2019 jedes Jahr zweistelliges Wachstum; Neue Branchen & Regionen bieten Gestaltungsspielraum und Potenzial. Starkes Gesamtpaket : Attraktives OTE, Mobilitätsbudget (Deutschlandticket), Urban‑Sports‑Partnerschaft, 30 Urlaubstage, Workation‑Optionen, Volunteering‑Day und 1.000 € Learning‑Budget. Sicherheit & Flexibilität : ISO 27001 / TISAX zertifiziert, DSGVO‑konform, Deployments in Cloud oder On‑Premises – und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das sich deinem Leben anpasst. title: Head of Marketing & Growth (w/m/d)
description: Über STUR Wir sind das Berliner Startup STUR: Wir entwickeln zeitlose, langlebige und nachhaltige Designprodukte für die Küche. Alles Made in Germany - unsere Gusseisenpfannen sind preisgekrönt. Wir möchten Foodies wie dich zu neuen kulinarischen Entdeckungen inspirieren und die Profiküche zu dir nach Hause bringen. Wir haben ein funktionierendes, profitables Geschäftsmodell, wachsen dynamisch und wollen bis 2030 in einer Million Küchen zu finden sein. Um das zu erreichen, denken wir Performance Marketing und Branding aus einem Guss. Und hierfür suchen wir nun dich als Head of Marketing & Growth (w/m/d). (deutschsprachig, ab sofort, hybrid in Berlin oder remote). Deine Aufgaben Verantwortung für Umsatz und Marketingeffizienz : Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unser zukünftiges Wachstum und die weitere Profitabilität unserer Marke. Hierzu gehört es, STUR weiter emotional als High-End-Brand zu positionieren sowie die gesamte Klaviatur der Performance-Kanäle abzudecken. Strategie : Zusammen mit unseren Co-Foundern entwickelst du die Marketingstrategie weiter und arbeitest an der kontinuierlichen Umsetzung. Du entwickelst und etablierst Prozesse und Strukturen, die weiteres Wachstum ermöglichen. Leadership : Du leitest ein dreiköpfiges Team und baust es langfristig weiter aus. Dabei führst du auf Augenhöhe und förderst die individuelle Entwicklung deiner Teammitglieder. Hands-on-Umsetzung : Zusammen mit deinem Team sowie Agenturen und Freelancer*innen setzt du die Strategie in Kampagnen um (aktuell v.a. Meta Ads, Google Ads, CRM und Influencer). Du steuerst das Testing und optimierst laufend unsere Conversion-Rate. Datenbasierte Entscheidungen : Du triffst deine Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten, entwickelst Reporting- und KPI-Strukturen weiter und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Dein Profil Du besitzt mehrjährige fundierte Berufserfahrung im Onlinemarketing in stark wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen und hast ausgeprägte Erfahrung in der Full-Funnel-Steuerung. Du hast Erfahrung im Aufbau einer Premium-D2C-Marke, die hohe AOVs erzielt, und dabei eine Umsatzverantwortung im mindestens achtstelligen Bereich gehabt. Du hast bereits Teams aufgebaut, geführt und langfristig weiterentwickelt. Gleichzeitig hast du Lust, Kampagnen in den gängigen Paid- und Organic-Channels hands-on selbst zu steuern. Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Creatives als zentraler Performance-Hebel. Mit deiner Kreativität und deinem Markenverständnis entwickelst du STUR langfristig zur Love-Brand. Du hast Spaß an der Analyse von Daten, arbeitest mit Attributionstools und kennst deren Grenzen. Mit Tools wie Klar bist du vertraut. Du besitzt eine große Passion für moderne Küche, kochst gern und kannst dich mit unseren ikonischen, nachhaltigen und funktionalen Made-in-Germany-Produkten identifizieren. Dein Deutsch ist fließend in Wort und Schrift, dein Englisch ist konversationssicher. Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens in München suchen wir Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als „Auftragskoordinator Produktionsplanung (m/w/d)“.

Aufgaben

  • Als Produktionsplaner (m/w/d) erstellen und steuern Sie standortübergreifende Produktions- und Grobplanungen unter Berücksichtigung von Kapazitäten und Terminen

  • Erforderlich sind fundierte Kenntnisse in der Auftragsplanung, Fertigungssteuerung sowie im Umgang mit Produktions- und Supply-Chain-Prozessen
  • Zusätzlich sind sichere Kenntnisse in SAP sowie MS Office relevant
  • Wichtig sind analytisches Denkvermögen, ausgeprägte Organisations- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und Kommunikationsstärke

  • Wertschätzende Arbeitskultur: Die Abteilung legt großen Wert auf ein positives Miteinander

About AgentixLake

AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities.

Your role

Build the pipelines and data models that people can depend on. You will own defined components of our data engineering projects, from understanding a source system to delivering tested transformations and monitoring how they run.

Our data platform engineering work connects operational systems with analytics and AI applications. Depending on the project, you will work with cloud warehouses, lakehouse architectures and the data quality and reliability practices that support production use.

What you will do

Build Python and SQL pipelines to ingest and transform data from APIs, databases, files or event sources.

Develop data models and dbt transformations with clear definitions, tests and documentation.

Implement incremental processing, schema checks and reconciliation so changes and data issues are visible.

Configure orchestration and monitoring; investigate failed runs and improve recovery and troubleshooting.

Contribute to cloud data platform components, infrastructure configuration and deployment workflows.

Use Git, pull requests and code review to deliver maintainable changes and explain their impact on downstream users.

What you bring

Current university enrolment in computer science, data science, business informatics or a related technical discipline.

Strong SQL and practical Python, supported by pipelines or data models you have built and maintained for actual users or team workflows.

A sound understanding of data modelling, incremental loads, data quality and the operational behaviour of scheduled pipelines.

Experience with version control and testing, plus practical exposure to a cloud platform, warehouse or orchestration tool.

The ability to own a well-scoped deliverable, investigate problems systematically and communicate clearly in English.

Experience with dbt, Airflow, Dagster, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Apache Iceberg or Terraform is valuable. You do not need experience with every technology; show us where you have developed depth.

What you can expect

You will work on data systems with clear users and delivery requirements, collaborate directly with experienced engineers and the founders, and receive substantive code review. Your part-time responsibilities and schedule will be planned around your studies.

Use the Apply button on this page to submit your CV, current study details, location and weekly availability. title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
description: <h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.</p> <p>We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.</p> <p>When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.</p> <p>The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.</p> <p>The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.</p> <p>In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.</p> <p>This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Your responsibilities will include:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.</li> <li>Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.</li> <li>Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.</li> <li>Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.</li> <li>Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.</li> <li>Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.</li> <li>Partner with the data and vertical product owners on what our corpus needs to contain and how results should be shaped per industry.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">We expect you to have:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent on high-scale search or ranking systems: web search, feed ranking at a large social platform, or a large ad engine.</li> <li>A background as an engineer, ML engineer, or researcher on a production system in one of those areas. This is a requirement rather than a preference. You will be making tradeoff calls alongside senior search engineers, and you need to have built something at that scale yourself.</li> <li>Direct experience shipping a search or ranking change end to end, including how it was evaluated and what happened after it shipped.</li> <li>A strong data foundation: you can design an experiment, read eval results critically, and tell a real quality improvement from noise.</li> <li>Product judgment to match the technical depth: you can decide what to build and what to leave, and defend it to both engineers and customers.</li> <li>Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how retrieval fits into agentic workflows.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, moving between strategy and execution without losing the thread.</li> <li>The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">It will be an added bonus if you have:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;<br></span></p> <ul> <li>Depth in information retrieval, NLP, or applied machine learning beyond what the role requires.</li> <li>Experience with index tiering, sharding, freshness pipelines, or cost-per-query optimisation at scale.</li> <li>Experience with hybrid retrieval, semantic and lexical search, re-ranking, or human evaluation programs.</li> <li>Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses running both self-serve and enterprise motions.</li> <li>Experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.</li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!

Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:

  • Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.

  • The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.

  • Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.

  • Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.

  • Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.

  • Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).

  • High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.

  • Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.

  • Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.

  • A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.

  • You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.

  • You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.

  • You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.

  • You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.

  • Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.

  • Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!

Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:

  • Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.

  • The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.

  • Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.

  • Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.

  • Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.

  • Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).

  • High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.

  • Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.

  • Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.

  • A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.

  • You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.

  • You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.

  • You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.

  • You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.

  • Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.

  • Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.
