We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Staff Security Operations Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team at Pleo. In this role, you'll define and deliver the SecOps roadmap, building the detection, response, and investigation capability that protects a fast-growing fintech. If you're excited about owning a security operations function end to end, from framework-based strategy through to the code that makes it run, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our VP of Fraud & Security and work closely with Fraud, DevSecOps, Engineering, and Risk & Compliance. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to protecting Pleo's customers and their money. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across the organisation and to bring less experienced security engineers up with you as the function matures.

What you'll be doing

As a Staff Security Operations Engineer, you will:

  • Build and own a structured SecOps roadmap grounded in well-known frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and CIS benchmarks.

  • Lead security investigations and digital forensics, from suspicious traffic through to full incident response, and bring the findings back into how we detect and prevent.

  • Design, tune, and scale our SIEM and logging pipeline through standardized log ingestion across services so signal isn't lost in the noise.

  • Strengthen our perimeter and authentication posture, including WAF configuration, authorisation tuning, and monitoring for suspicious traffic.

  • Protect sensitive data through DLP controls, and make sure the coverage matches where the data actually lives.

  • Improve our on-call rotation for the team, defining the alerting, escalation paths, and response SLAs that make it work.

  • Automate detection and response workflows, using code and AI to reduce manual toil and shorten time to resolution.

  • Reduce SecOps-attributed risk identified through compliance gaps, and collect the evidence that demonstrates it.

  • Build dashboards and reporting that give the team and leadership real visibility into response times, coverage, and risk reduction.

  • Work cross-functionally with engineers who don't have a security background, translating threat models into changes they can actually ship.

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or a closely related discipline, with a proven track record of materialised risk reduction through monetary impact, incidents contained, forensics that changed outcomes.

  • A strong development and engineering background. You are comfortable writing the automation, not just specifying it.

  • Hands-on SOC and SIEM management experience, including detection engineering and log pipeline design.

  • Experience in scale-up environments, where you've built capability rather than inherited a mature one.

  • A strong understanding of cloud architectures as we use AWS. With part of our estate on GCP and how infrastructure decisions shape detection and response.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI and/or coding automation to get security controls built, implemented, and operating in practice.

  • Fintech, payments, fraud, or trust & safety experience is a real advantage, as is exposure to highly regulated environments.

  • Backgrounds that tend to do well here: incident response, IR management, SOC engineering, security engineering, DevSecOps, red or blue team.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want a large blast radius. We have high-impact projects where the outcome shows up in real business metrics, at a pre-IPO company.

  • You're energised by building a function rather than maintaining one, and you'd rather set the roadmap than be handed it.

  • You enjoy raising the bar around you, growing a team of specialists and lifting the people already here.

  • You're equally at home in a threat model discussion and in an editor writing the automation that acts on it.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You need a well-groomed backlog and assigned tasks in order to do your best work.

  • You'd rather stay purely strategic than get hands-on with the tooling.

  • You're not up for participating in an on-call rotation.

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Get deep into Pleo's security landscape and our detection coverage, our logging estate, our cloud footprint to form your own view of where the biggest risks sit.

  • Publish a SecOps roadmap mapped to MITRE, NIST, and CIS, agree with Engineering, Risk & Compliance, and leadership, and start delivering against it.

  • Stand up the on-call rotation and the alert response SLAs that go with it.

  • Ship your first wave of detection and automation improvements, and establish the KPIs that show what changed.

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills. There's genuine room here for the scope of this role to grow, including into people leadership.

The location

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25-28 days of holiday (depending on your location) + public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager interview: a 60-minute conversation covering your experience, how you approach security operations, and how you communicate.

  3. Technical deep dive: a 60-minute session with two of our SecOps engineers, going deep on SIEM, detection engineering, your coding and automation experience.

  4. Cross-functional interview: a 45-minute conversation with DevSecOps and Engineering leadership on how you work across team boundaries with other senior engineers.

raw.title: Staff Security Operations Engineer
raw.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Staff Security Operations Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team at Pleo. In this role, you'll define and deliver the SecOps roadmap, building the detection, response, and investigation capability that protects a fast-growing fintech. If you're excited about owning a security operations function end to end, from framework-based strategy through to the code that makes it run, then this is the opportunity for you!

 

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our VP of Fraud & Security and work closely with Fraud, DevSecOps, Engineering, and Risk & Compliance. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to protecting Pleo's customers and their money. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across the organisation and to bring less experienced security engineers up with you as the function matures.

 

What you'll be doing

As a Staff Security Operations Engineer, you will:

  • Build and own a structured SecOps roadmap grounded in well-known frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and CIS benchmarks.

  • Lead security investigations and digital forensics, from suspicious traffic through to full incident response, and bring the findings back into how we detect and prevent.

  • Design, tune, and scale our SIEM and logging pipeline through standardized log ingestion across services so signal isn't lost in the noise.

  • Strengthen our perimeter and authentication posture, including WAF configuration, authorisation tuning, and monitoring for suspicious traffic.

  • Protect sensitive data through DLP controls, and make sure the coverage matches where the data actually lives.

  • Improve our on-call rotation for the team, defining the alerting, escalation paths, and response SLAs that make it work.

  • Automate detection and response workflows, using code and AI to reduce manual toil and shorten time to resolution.

  • Reduce SecOps-attributed risk identified through compliance gaps, and collect the evidence that demonstrates it.

  • Build dashboards and reporting that give the team and leadership real visibility into response times, coverage, and risk reduction.

  • Work cross-functionally with engineers who don't have a security background, translating threat models into changes they can actually ship.

 

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or a closely related discipline, with a proven track record of materialised risk reduction through monetary impact, incidents contained, forensics that changed outcomes.

  • A strong development and engineering background. You are comfortable writing the automation, not just specifying it.

  • Hands-on SOC and SIEM management experience, including detection engineering and log pipeline design.

  • Experience in scale-up environments, where you've built capability rather than inherited a mature one.

  • A strong understanding of cloud architectures as we use AWS. With part of our estate on GCP and how infrastructure decisions shape detection and response.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI and/or coding automation to get security controls built, implemented, and operating in practice.

  • Fintech, payments, fraud, or trust & safety experience is a real advantage, as is exposure to highly regulated environments.

  • Backgrounds that tend to do well here: incident response, IR management, SOC engineering, security engineering, DevSecOps, red or blue team.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want a large blast radius. We have high-impact projects where the outcome shows up in real business metrics, at a pre-IPO company.

  • You're energised by building a function rather than maintaining one, and you'd rather set the roadmap than be handed it.

  • You enjoy raising the bar around you, growing a team of specialists and lifting the people already here.

  • You're equally at home in a threat model discussion and in an editor writing the automation that acts on it.

 

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You need a well-groomed backlog and assigned tasks in order to do your best work.

  • You'd rather stay purely strategic than get hands-on with the tooling.

  • You're not up for participating in an on-call rotation.

 
 

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Get deep into Pleo's security landscape and our detection coverage, our logging estate, our cloud footprint to form your own view of where the biggest risks sit.

  • Publish a SecOps roadmap mapped to MITRE, NIST, and CIS, agree with Engineering, Risk & Compliance, and leadership, and start delivering against it.

  • Stand up the on-call rotation and the alert response SLAs that go with it.

  • Ship your first wave of detection and automation improvements, and establish the KPIs that show what changed.

 

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills. There's genuine room here for the scope of this role to grow, including into people leadership.

 

The location

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25-28 days of holiday (depending on your location) + public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

 

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

 

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager interview: a 60-minute conversation covering your experience, how you approach security operations, and how you communicate.

  3. Technical deep dive: a 60-minute session with two of our SecOps engineers, going deep on SIEM, detection engineering, your coding and automation experience.

  4. Cross-functional interview: a 45-minute conversation with DevSecOps and Engineering leadership on how you work across team boundaries with other senior engineers.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Dispenser
description: About Bolt Pharmacy and AIOS AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025 : We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026 : Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028 : Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030 : Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035 : With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy We are building a world-class team. As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace. You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it. You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving. Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team. Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence. This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns. You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski . You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support. Key responsibilities Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists. Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance. Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately. Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed. Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements. Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates. Need to have Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification. Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety. Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation. Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist. Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance. Nice to have Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser. Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely. Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly. Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied. Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism. Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice. Our cultural standards We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members: Belief in the mission : We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission. Unwavering integrity : We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity. Only the paranoid survive : Bad sh*t is coming. AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy

We are building a world-class team.

As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace.

You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it.

You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving.

Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team.

Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support.

Key responsibilities

  • Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists.

  • Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance.

  • Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately.

  • Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed.

  • Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements.

  • Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates.

Need to have

  • Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification.

  • Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety.

  • Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation.

  • Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist.

  • Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance.

Nice to have

  • Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser.

  • Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely.

  • Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly.

  • Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied.

  • Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism.

  • Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

  • Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

  • Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills.

  • Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing.

  • GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable.

  • Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm.

  • What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Our mobile app, Zable, is how most of our customers experience all of our products in one centralised space. It's written in React Native and TypeScript with a Kotlin backend, shipped to iOS and Android from a single codebase. We are now looking to level up the quality engineering so that we can raise release cadence without losing sleep over regressions.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers, rather than executing test scripts by hand. You'll work alongside software engineers, product, and design, setting direction.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

What you'll be doing

Own the mobile test strategy:

  • Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests).

  • Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app.

  • Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it.

Build reliable E2E automation:

  • Create and maintain mobile E2E suites in Maestro, including the scaffolding around them - test data, device configuration, helpers, reporting.

  • Integrate suites into CI (GitHub Actions) so engineers get fast, trustworthy feedback on every PR and release candidates carry a signal people actually believe.

  • Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green.

Bring AI into the SDLC:

  • Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes.

  • Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on.

  • Help shape how the mobile team uses AI-assisted workflows more broadly - prompts, guardrails, review patterns.

Prevent defects, not just catch them:

  • Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written.

  • Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact.

  • Run targeted exploratory testing on high-risk releases when it's the right call.

What we're looking for

Essential:

  • Hands-on experience with Maestro or Detox.

  • 6+ years in quality engineering or test automation, with a track record of keeping automated suites stable rather than letting them rot into a graveyard of quarantined tests.

  • Experience introducing AI-assisted testing practices (test generation, failure clustering, coverage analytics) with sensible controls around review and trust.

  • Strong TypeScript and JavaScript - not just writing test scripts, but building helpers, tooling, and debugging into the app when needed.

  • Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control.

  • Comfortable with mobile E2E automation, or strong E2E experience on another platform plus a credible plan for getting productive on mobile quickly.

  • Able to operate independently and drive improvements end-to-end (frameworks, CI, test data, reporting).

Desirable:

  • Hands-on experience testing React Native apps.

  • Mobile performance and reliability work (crash reporting, startup time, memory and battery awareness).

  • API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy.

Our tech stack

Mobile: TypeScript, React Native, Expo, EAS, GraphQL, Relay, Jest, React Testing Library, Maestro.

Backend: Kotlin, PHP 8 (Symfony), AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

Interview process

  1. Quick call with a Recruiter

  2. 15 minute cognitive test

  3. Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)

  4. Technical interview (90 minutes)

  5. Culture-add interview (60 minutes)

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. raw.title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

  • Full sales cycle: From prospection to closing

  • Education & demos: Deliver inspiring product demonstrations and guide stakeholders through the evaluation process

The Alan way of selling

You will join Alan's Corporate team, the unit that covers legal, privacy, governance, risk, compliance and security as Alan scales.

🤝 Your missions

Corporate protects Alan and its members, but regulated work can still be slow, manual and disconnected from how we build. You are here to build the compliance product that fixes that: processes and tooling that hold as Alan grows, and that make regulated work lighter on both sides, for the teams you serve and for the experts you work with.

  • Make regulated work scale. Alan's regulatory load grows with every new member, market and product. You build the layer that absorbs it, so Corporate's load stops climbing in lockstep with the company: a clear path from each request to the right owner, and tooling that takes on the recurring work.

  • Rebuild processes end to end. You find the painful process, work out what people are really doing to get around it, and redesign it so it is faster for everyone. You stay on it after launch, watch how it is used, and keep improving it until it becomes the way people work.

  • Build practical automation and AI-enabled workflows from end-to-end. You identify where no-code, low-code, AI tools or other forms of automation can remove repetitive work, improve consistency and help people make better decisions. You design workflows that combine tools, data, controls and human judgment appropriately.

  • Spot the next bottleneck before it bites. You design solutions that keep Alan compliant and fast at the same time, rather than trading one for the other.

  • Measure what you ship. You set clear goals and check them, so every change makes life easier on both sides: the Corporate team you work with and the people they serve.

  • Shipped a first system that gives the teams you serve one simple, fast way to get what they need from Corporate.

  • Owned at least one process from problem to a live, automated solution that people actually use.

  • Become a trusted, pragmatic builder for the Corporate team and for the people they serve.

  • Established a clear approach to measuring adoption, quality, efficiency and continuous improvement.

🚀 Profile we are looking for

What you bring

  • You have a taste for efficient processes. You have turned manual, repetitive work into simple automated and AI based workflows. You can explain what you built, why you built it and how people used it.

  • You created AI-enabled workflows. You are familiar with current AI tools and have experimented with using them to improve research, decision-making, knowledge work or operations. You are interested not only in using AI tools, but also in combining them into reliable workflows that solve real problems.

  • You are drawn to regulated work. You want to understand why these processes exist and where they create friction, and you ramp up fast on a domain that is new to you. Hands-on experience in one of these areas is a plus that speeds your ramp-up, not a requirement.

  • French and English (professional level).

Qualities we look for to join our team

  • Builder mindset: You can operate independently, make progress with incomplete information, prioritise ruthlessly, involve the right experts and bring a project to a useful outcome without waiting for perfect certainty.

  • Explorer mindset: You are curious about a vague problem, dig deep to frame it well, stay solution-oriented, and escalate early.

  • Systems thinking: You look beyond isolated tasks and understand how people, processes, tools, data and controls fit together.

  • Appetite for regulated complexity: The complexity of regulated work energises you as much as the tooling does, and you approach it with a try-and-retry, challenger mindset.

  • Sound judgment: You sense where a shortcut would break a legal, privacy, security or compliance requirement, and you know when to stop and ask.

  • Project ownership: You drive projects end to end, from user research and planning to delivery, and you own what happens after launch: adoption and continuous improvement.

title: Médecin Généraliste - Alan Précision 🩸
description: 🐻 Qui est Alan ? En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé . La Clinique Alan réunit plus de 120 professionnels de santé disponibles 7j/7 : médecins généralistes, sages-femmes, psychologues, kinésithérapeutes, dermatologues, pédiatres, nutritionnistes, infirmières puéricultrices. Nos membres bénéficient d'une prise en charge véritablement intégrée : 🩺 Téléconsultation vidéo : pour les situations qui nécessitent une consultation médicale en direct 💬 Chat médical : conseils de professionnels de santé, 7j/7, réponse en moins de 30 minutes 🤖 Mo, notre compagnon santé IA : répond instantanément aux questions du quotidien, avec des réponses relues et validées par nos médecins 🎯 Des programmes de prévention (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés 🧘 Alan Play : une approche ludique de la prévention autour de l'activité physique, du bien-être mental et de la cohésion d'équipe 🩸 Qu’est-ce qu’Alan Précision ? Il s’agit de notre tout nouveau programme de prévention ; un service de santé préventive avancée, à la croisée de la médecine de précision, de la biologie et du mode de vie. Le constat : en France, il y a environ 12 ans d’écart entre l’espérance de vie et l’espérance de vie en bonne santé, et plus de la moitié des maladies chroniques sont évitables. Plutôt que d’attendre les symptômes, nous repérons les signaux biologiques précoces et nous les traduisons en actions concrètes . Le service repose sur trois briques : 💉 Un bilan sanguin de plus de 80 biomarqueurs et ratios , réalisé dans plus de 300 laboratoires partenaires. Il couvre le cardiovasculaire (ApoB, Lp(a)…), le métabolisme (insuline, HOMA-IR, HbA1c), le foie, le rein, la thyroïde, l’inflammation (hs-CRP), les micronutriments et les hormones. 💬 Un questionnaire d’environ 200 questions sur le mode de vie, les objectifs et les antécédents. 🎯 Un rapport personnalisé généré par IA et validé par nos médecins , qui contient l’analyse de chaque biomarqueur en contexte, un Score de Santé, un Âge Biologique, des recommandations sur le mode de vie et un plan d’action avec 3-5 objectifs prioritaires basés sur les grands “piliers” de la prévention (activité physique, nutrition, santé mentale, sommeil, …). 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Nous recrutons des médecins généralistes curieux de prévention et de médecine de précision , pour rejoindre le petit groupe de médecins qui relisent et valident les rapports Alan Précision. ✅ Curieux(se) de ce que l’IA peut apporter à la pratique ✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients ✅ Un vrai intérêt pour la thématique et l'envie d'apprendre : un DU (nutrition, prévention…) est un plus, mais pas indispensable ✅ Disponible au moins 4h par semaine (horaires flexibles) ✅ Statut libéral 🧠 Votre rôle : le regard médical qui fait la différence L’IA prépare, vous validez. Avant d’arriver chez le membre, chaque rapport passe entre vos mains : vous en êtes le garant médical, et c’est votre expertise qui en fait un rapport fiable et utile. Concrètement, vous : Relisez le rapport généré par l’IA et vérifier son exactitude médicale Vous vous assurez que les interprétations collent au profil de la personne (âge, sexe, activité, habitudes) Apportez la nuance que seul un médecin sait apporter : un lien de causalité trop affirmatif (« est causé par » doit devenir « peut être lié à ») une formulation anxiogène une incohérence entre les sections du rapport une recommandation qui ne correspond pas au profil une supplémentation exotique ou mal étayée Êtes le filet de sécurité : vous bloquez et faites remonter les situations qui sortent du cadre de la prévention (valeur critique, pathologie active suspectée, interaction médicamenteuse…) Signalez les erreurs récurrentes de l’IA : vos corrections servent directement à améliorer les rapports suivants A noter : Vous n’écrivez pas les rapports, vous ne prescrivez pas, et vous n’échangez pas directement avec les utilisateurs. Les résultats biologiques arrivent automatiquement par MSSanté. Tout se fait en asynchrone : pas de créneau fixe, pas de patient qui attend. Vous relisez les rapports quand vous voulez — le soir, entre deux consultations, le week-end. Il s'agit donc d'une activité complémentaire idéale pour diversifier votre exercice, sans salle d’attente ni urgence . 🙌 Pourquoi rejoindre Alan ? 🔬 Une thématique passionnante . Médecine de précision, biomarqueurs, prévention avancée qui associe biologie et mode de vie : une approche encore rare en France, que vous pratiquerez au quotidien. Enfin le temps de faire de la prévention approfondie, celle qu'une consultation de 15 minutes ne permet pas. 🎓 Une expertise qui enrichit votre pratique . Vous développez des compétences rares (ApoB, Lp(a), insulinorésistance, micronutrition…) que vous pourrez aussi mobiliser auprès de vos propres patients. 📚 Formation et partage . Onboarding et formation à la médecine de précision, sessions d'échange entre médecins, veille scientifique. 🏥 Un cadre médical structuré . Vous exercez dans un cadre clair, conforme aux exigences réglementaires et déontologiques, pour des prises en charge cohérentes, harmonisées et sécurisées. Des médecins référents vous accompagnent dans les situations cliniques difficiles. 🤝 Un petit groupe de pionniers . Au-delà de la mission freelance, vous rejoignez la communauté d'une dizaine de médecins qui construisent Alan Précision : partage de connaissances, échanges sur les cas, et vos retours qui orientent directement l'évolution du produit. raw.title: Médecin Généraliste - Alan Précision 🩸
raw.description:
🐻 Qui est Alan ?

En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé.

La Clinique Alan réunit plus de 120 professionnels de santé disponibles 7j/7 : médecins généralistes, sages-femmes, psychologues, kinésithérapeutes, dermatologues, pédiatres, nutritionnistes, infirmières puéricultrices.

Nos membres bénéficient d'une prise en charge véritablement intégrée :

  • 🩺 Téléconsultation vidéo : pour les situations qui nécessitent une consultation médicale en direct

  • 💬 Chat médical : conseils de professionnels de santé, 7j/7, réponse en moins de 30 minutes

  • 🤖 Mo, notre compagnon santé IA : répond instantanément aux questions du quotidien, avec des réponses relues et validées par nos médecins

  • 🎯 Des programmes de prévention (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés

  • 🧘 Alan Play : une approche ludique de la prévention autour de l'activité physique, du bien-être mental et de la cohésion d'équipe

🩸 Qu’est-ce qu’Alan Précision ?

Il s’agit de notre tout nouveau programme de prévention ; un service de santé préventive avancée, à la croisée de la médecine de précision, de la biologie et du mode de vie.

Le constat : en France, il y a environ 12 ans d’écart entre l’espérance de vie et l’espérance de vie en bonne santé, et plus de la moitié des maladies chroniques sont évitables. Plutôt que d’attendre les symptômes, nous repérons les signaux biologiques précoces et nous les traduisons en actions concrètes.

Le service repose sur trois briques :

  • 💉 Un bilan sanguin de plus de 80 biomarqueurs et ratios, réalisé dans plus de 300 laboratoires partenaires. Il couvre le cardiovasculaire (ApoB, Lp(a)…), le métabolisme (insuline, HOMA-IR, HbA1c), le foie, le rein, la thyroïde, l’inflammation (hs-CRP), les micronutriments et les hormones.

  • 💬 Un questionnaire d’environ 200 questions sur le mode de vie, les objectifs et les antécédents.

  • 🎯 Un rapport personnalisé généré par IA et validé par nos médecins, qui contient l’analyse de chaque biomarqueur en contexte, un Score de Santé, un Âge Biologique, des recommandations sur le mode de vie et un plan d’action avec 3-5 objectifs prioritaires basés sur les grands “piliers” de la prévention (activité physique, nutrition, santé mentale, sommeil, …).

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recrutons des médecins généralistes curieux de prévention et de médecine de précision, pour rejoindre le petit groupe de médecins qui relisent et valident les rapports Alan Précision.

  • ✅ Curieux(se) de ce que l’IA peut apporter à la pratique

  • ✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients

  • ✅ Un vrai intérêt pour la thématique et l'envie d'apprendre : un DU (nutrition, prévention…) est un plus, mais pas indispensable

  • ✅ Disponible au moins 4h par semaine (horaires flexibles)

  • ✅ Statut libéral

🧠 Votre rôle : le regard médical qui fait la différence

L’IA prépare, vous validez. Avant d’arriver chez le membre, chaque rapport passe entre vos mains : vous en êtes le garant médical, et c’est votre expertise qui en fait un rapport fiable et utile.

Concrètement, vous :

  • Relisez le rapport généré par l’IA et vérifier son exactitude médicale

  • Vous vous assurez que les interprétations collent au profil de la personne (âge, sexe, activité, habitudes)

  • Apportez la nuance que seul un médecin sait apporter :

    • un lien de causalité trop affirmatif (« est causé par » doit devenir « peut être lié à »)

    • une formulation anxiogène

    • une incohérence entre les sections du rapport

    • une recommandation qui ne correspond pas au profil

    • une supplémentation exotique ou mal étayée

  • Êtes le filet de sécurité : vous bloquez et faites remonter les situations qui sortent du cadre de la prévention (valeur critique, pathologie active suspectée, interaction médicamenteuse…)

  • Signalez les erreurs récurrentes de l’IA : vos corrections servent directement à améliorer les rapports suivants

A noter:

  • Vous n’écrivez pas les rapports, vous ne prescrivez pas, et vous n’échangez pas directement avec les utilisateurs. Les résultats biologiques arrivent automatiquement par MSSanté.

  • Tout se fait en asynchrone : pas de créneau fixe, pas de patient qui attend. Vous relisez les rapports quand vous voulez — le soir, entre deux consultations, le week-end.

  • Il s'agit donc d'une activité complémentaire idéale pour diversifier votre exercice, sans salle d’attente ni urgence.

     

🙌 Pourquoi rejoindre Alan ?

  • 🔬 Une thématique passionnante. Médecine de précision, biomarqueurs, prévention avancée qui associe biologie et mode de vie : une approche encore rare en France, que vous pratiquerez au quotidien. Enfin le temps de faire de la prévention approfondie, celle qu'une consultation de 15 minutes ne permet pas.

  • 🎓 Une expertise qui enrichit votre pratique. Vous développez des compétences rares (ApoB, Lp(a), insulinorésistance, micronutrition…) que vous pourrez aussi mobiliser auprès de vos propres patients.

  • 📚 Formation et partage. Onboarding et formation à la médecine de précision, sessions d'échange entre médecins, veille scientifique.

  • 🏥 Un cadre médical structuré. Vous exercez dans un cadre clair, conforme aux exigences réglementaires et déontologiques, pour des prises en charge cohérentes, harmonisées et sécurisées. Des médecins référents vous accompagnent dans les situations cliniques difficiles.

  • 🤝 Un petit groupe de pionniers. Au-delà de la mission freelance, vous rejoignez la communauté d'une dizaine de médecins qui construisent Alan Précision : partage de connaissances, échanges sur les cas, et vos retours qui orientent directement l'évolution du produit. Vous faites aussi partie de la Clinic Alan et de ses plus de 120 professionnels de santé.

  • 🤖 Co-construire l'avenir de la médecine. Quelle place pour l'IA dans le parcours de soin? Chez Alan, les médecins sont au cœur de ces réflexions et impliqués dans son développement.

  • 💰 Des conditions attractives. Nous proposons une rémunération attractive (70€/h), une grande flexibilité d’organisation (travail 100 % asynchrone et à distance) et l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une communauté médicale engagée.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques pour rejoindre le département INFRES à Télécom Paris. Le poste est accueilli au sein de Quriosity, équipe commune à Inria et Télécom Paris, au laboratoire LTCI et au département Informatique et Réseaux (INFRES). Située à Palaiseau, sur le plateau de Saclay, l’équipe bénéficie d’un environnement actif en information quantique et en fondements de la théorie quantique. Le recrutement relève du projet PIQ « Nouveaux outils algébriques pour les décompositions causales des processus quantiques », sous la responsabilité d’Augustin Vanrietvelde. Il porte sur la phase 1 du projet, pour une durée de 18 mois. Le projet étudie la conjecture des décompositions causales : tout canal unitaire admettrait une décomposition dont les connexions reflètent fidèlement sa structure causale. L’objectif est de développer des outils algébriques et syntaxiques pour étudier des cas ouverts, construire des décompositions ou identifier des obstructions. La recherche est exploratoire ; les résultats partiels et les limites des méthodes seront documentés. Vos principales missions seront de : Mener des recherches sur les décompositions causales des processus quantiques dans le cadre de la phase 1 du projet PIQ. Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat de projets étudiants et de stages. Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique de Télécom Paris, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en physique, mathématiques, informatique ou dans une discipline pertinente pour le projet, obtenu au plus tard à la prise de fonctions. About lemlist

lemlist is a global B2B SaaS business with one mission: help any business grow.

We’re doing 60M+ ARR, while being:

  • 170 people, remote-friendly, agile

We run two product lines:

  • Sales Engagement with lemlist & Claap ($50M ARR, growing +60% YoY)

  • Social selling with Taplio & Tweet Hunter ($4.5M ARR)

Our ambition: become a world-class giant in Sales Tech.

Our mantra: Keep growing.

About the role

We’re looking for a Staff Engineer to join our team.

You’ll design, build, and ship features across frontend and backend, improve performance, and progressively take leadership on more transversal topics, mentor peers, and drive delivery.

What you’ll do

  • Build new features end-to-end (frontend + backend) by working hand-in-hand with a strong Product team

  • Improve the codebase (refactoring, bug fixes, optimization)

  • Collaborate with the rest of the team to solve technical issues

  • Mentor fellow developers, share knowledge, and raise the bar

  • Step up as Tech Lead on specific topics: drive quality, make technical choices, and align delivery

  • Solve difficult problems that impact 10,000s of customers every day

What success looks like

Within 3 months

  • You’re fully onboarded and comfortable in our stack

  • You’ve shipped meaningful features in production

  • You’ve contributed to improving our codebase

  • You've brought knowledge to the team that made other people improve

Within 12 months

  • You’ve led delivery of multiple successful projects

  • You’ve had direct impact on scalability & performance

  • You’ve grown into your an internal reference on some technical topics and mentor others

What’s in it for you

  • Join a bootstrapped, profitable, fast-growing SaaS company

  • Build products used by thousands of businesses worldwide

  • See your impact quickly with a very short feedback loop

  • Work with senior engineers who love to learn and share knowledge

  • Remote-first culture (office in Paris if you prefer 🇫🇷)

  • No endless meetings, high autonomy, big impact

About you

Must have

  • 10+ years in Software Engineering

  • 7+ years in JavaScript/TypeScript (frontend + backend)

  • Solid skills in Node.js, React, MongoDB

  • Proven track record building & maintaining web apps

  • Always hungry to learn more

  • Autonomous, fast learner, and collaborative

  • Fluent in French & English, based in French timezone (+/- 2h)

Nice to have

  • B2B SaaS startup experience

  • Self-taught hacker or side-project builder

  • Passionate about experimenting & creating beyond work

Package

  • 75-90K€ base salary

  • Profit sharing: when lemlist wins, you win too

  • Full perks: Alan Blue (healthcare) 100% taken care of for you and your family, Swile meal vouchers, 100% of your Navigo card, MacBook Pro & remote setup budget

  • Annual global team retreat in amazing locations 🌍

Recruitment process

  1. Interview with Lucas (TAM)

  2. Technical interview with Corentin (VP of Engineering)

  3. Technical interview with Mickael (CTO)

  4. Final chat with Charles (CEO)

raw.title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
raw.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.
